newsitem.title: FRANCE: Two Algerian parties awarded one more seat in vote.
newsitem.headline: Two Algerian parties awarded one more seat in vote.

text.p: Algeria's Constitutional Council, the highest election watchdog body, on Tuesday ruled on party complaints on the official outcome of the June 5 vote, giving one seat extra to two groups.

In a statement read on state-run television, the Council awarded one more seat to the secular opposition Socialist Forces Front for a total of 20 and another to the National Democratic Rally (RND), grouping President Liamine Zeroual's supporters, for a total of 156.

The former ruling National Liberation Front (FLN) lost two seats after the council ruling, said the statement, adding that the Council had kept the seat totals of other parties and independents unchanged.
